snippet.title: Seek and Destroy 1993 - Preview/Trailer/Demo Game
snippet.description:
Video had been recorded via DOSBox SVN, while the audio had been recorded from a Roland SC-88ST PRO.

The Roland Sound Canvas (SC-88STPro) is a desktop (aftertouch and velocity sensitive), 64 voice (multimbral), GS/GM compatible digital synthesizer (editable via MIDI only), featuring an oscillator, a resonant low-pass filter, an ADR envelope, vibrato (with delay), portamento, reverb/chorus/delay, 2-band EQ, multi-effects, 1117 presets, 42 drum sets, stereo mix inputs, dual stereo outputs, PC/Mac interface, and MIDI.
